faq.question: What kinds of SEO projects do you take?
faq.answer: I focus on technical SEO, programmatic SEO at scale, and entity-based optimization for SaaS, hosting, and tech companies. Projects typically include technical audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, structured data implementation, and programmatic content strategies. I provide measurable outcomes with full documentation and code access when applicable.

faq.question: Which tech stacks do you prefer for web applications?
faq.answer: My primary stacks are Laravel (PHP) for robust backends with extensive ecosystem support, Node.js for real-time applications and microservices, and Python for data processing and automation. I deploy on Linux environments (Ubuntu/Debian) with KVM virtualization and Docker containerization. For APIs, I build both RESTful and GraphQL architectures depending on client needs.

faq.question: How do you approach algorithmic trading research?
faq.answer: All research follows rigorous scientific methodology: data quality validation, walk-forward analysis, out-of-sample testing, and Monte Carlo simulations. I focus on systematic, rule-based strategies with clear risk management frameworks. All work is for research purposes only—I don't provide financial advice or manage funds. Results include full backtesting reports with transaction costs and slippage assumptions.

faq.question: Do you offer blockchain audits or only experiments?
faq.answer: I offer smart contract development, security reviews, and validator infrastructure setup. While I conduct thorough code reviews using industry-standard tools (Slither, Mythril, manual analysis), formal audits should be supplemented with specialized audit firms for production DeFi protocols. I'm best suited for development, architecture consulting, and infrastructure work in the blockchain space.

faq.question: How can we verify your results and expertise?
faq.answer: All case studies link to verifiable data: GitHub repositories for code, published articles for methodologies, and anonymized analytics screenshots for outcomes. My Medium publications detail technical approaches with reproducible steps. You can review my code quality on GitHub, read independent testimonials, and request references from past clients. I maintain transparency through open-source contributions and detailed documentation.
